_note: Deployment-side latency of the OFFICIAL PRETRAINED detector. Not a training or accuracy metric. Separate from the COCO reproduction, which answers a different question.

protocol.measured: detector forward + postprocess only; no decode, no tracking, no drawing

visual_servoing_implication.statement: The current GroundingDINO configuration is a detector-side real-time bottleneck for per-frame 30 FPS visual servoing.
visual_servoing_implication.not_established: This does NOT establish that GroundingDINO cannot be used for visual servoing. Lower input resolution, a reduced detection rate, other backbones and other hardware were not evaluated.
